body:
Build an unattended official Repo2RLEnv PR-to-task workflow with reproducible exports, independent native controls, durable evidence and owned cleanup, without per-task human/LLM repairs.

**Latest result:** #62 generated one fresh DendroPy export; #65 reused it after a qualified generic cache/import fix and completed independent controls: nop reward **0**, oracle reward **1**, target **0/1 → 1/1**, all **1,145 P2P tests passed on both sides**. Four untracked failures remain on both sides and oracle exits 1: **one tracked positive pair, zero strict clean-command eligible tasks**. [Evidence and limits](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/6544dcd596eae5f6ba088fa8b178fd9d916dd602/experiments/65-sealed-case-safe-export/results.md). Earlier negative results remain preserved.

**In progress:** #66 runs one fresh NiBabel input through the qualified connector, without regeneration or per-task repairs; retain strict quality checks. #64 investigates missed subtest failures, #56 provenance, #59 targeting limits and #60 compiled rebuilding separately. No parser/provenance/compiled change is silently adopted.

**Code/budget:** consolidated draft PR #63 passes **186 local tests and both GitHub CI checks**; main and earlier PRs remain unchanged/open. Settled incremental usage is **$1.723023 / 48 original model calls** and **14.041535/32 allocated CPUh**. Earlier jobs are terminal with verified archival/cleanup. #66 has 6.333333 CPUh and $13.07 model bound reserved before its original submission; existing $10 storage reserve unreconciled. Same $90 operating ceiling, strictly below $100 extra, reserved CPUs only. Detailed logs/accounting in comments.

Keep epic/children/PRs open for review; #28 stays closed. No automatic merge or release. Workflow completion, scientific acceptance and release readiness remain separate.
